startUrls.title: Website URLs
startUrls.description: One or more website URLs you are authorized to crawl.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages per website
maxPages.description: Includes the homepage. Keep this low and respect website policies.

enableEnrichment.title: Enable AI enrichment
enableEnrichment.description: Optional AI enrichment using your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint. Disabled by default.

llmApiUrl.title: LLM API URL
llmApiUrl.description: Complete API endpoint URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions. Required when AI enrichment is enabled.

llmApiKey.title: LLM API Key
llmApiKey.description: Your LLM API key. Leave empty if your endpoint does not require authentication.

llmModel.title: LLM Model
llmModel.description: Model identifier accepted by your endpoint. Required when AI enrichment is enabled.

llmTimeoutSecs.title: LLM Request Timeout (seconds)
llmTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time to wait for an LLM response.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time to wait for each website request.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Whether to honor robots.txt rules before crawling pages.

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: User-Agent header sent with website requests.
